name: Survey tile in Aries
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 1.6 degrees south of the ecliptic in Aries, imaged by SPHEREx 16 times in 4 visits over 46 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 34 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 2.7 days starting 2026-01-19, at wavelengths from 0.76 to 4.72 µm. The pipeline found 1 moving object.
